name: Loomcordial
description: Rest the blade's weight on the front shoulder with qi pooled in the back so the guandao hangs ready without strain.

name: Savage Guanpole
description: Let the blade's own weight fall in a curved cut and add a small qi pulse in the last palm's width.

name: Tuftflog
description: Bring the blade back up along its own path on the rebound and cut a second time as it rises.

name: Layered Guanhook
description: Roll the pole off the shoulder against a thrust and deflect it with the near end of the shaft.

name: Lithe Crescentback
description: Step in under the blade's arc as it passes so the next cut begins at closer range.

name: Tuftslap
description: Hurl the crescent's whole weight in a heavy overhead arc with qi pooled in the forearms to split a raised guard.

name: Tuftbarrier
description: Take a blow on the shaft then let the pole's spring throw the blade round in a returning cut.

name: Quickening Tailspike
description: Settle a steady stream of qi along the blade's full curve before the first cut is thrown.

name: Doughty Bladewheel
description: Cut straight ahead with the qi stream held at the edge so the blade bites deeper than bare steel.

name: Lassoing Slashdown
description: Hook the inner edge behind the opponent's weapon and draw it back to pull the weapon out of line.

name: Crestzip
description: Move sideways while the qi stream keeps the blade steady and its tip pointed at the foe.

name: Vicious Heavyblade
description: Push a surge of qi from the grip along the curve at the instant of contact so the edge bites through light armor.

name: Sturdy Redtassel
description: Let the incoming weapon slide along the blade's curve while qi in the shaft turns it off the body.

name: Genial Bladecollar
description: Plant the feet wide and twist the hips back so the stance stores the turn for a long sweep.

name: Guanbuckle
description: Hook the blade's inner curve behind the opponent's ankle and pull to knock the foot from under them.

name: Clay Rollcut
description: Swing the blade flat at hip height and carry it through the opponent's middle.

name: Lassoing Counterspike
description: Slide the hook up beneath an opponent's raised arm and heave to throw the weapon high.

name: Rillcrest
description: Keep the pole turning in a slow wheel before the body so blows from any side meet the shaft.

name: Lithe Heavyswing
description: Circle the front foot around the opponent's flank as the blade finishes its sweep.

name: Longsweep Thwack
description: Drive qi into a full wheeling sweep so the blade clears every attacker standing at its edge height.

name: Viselike Ironsweep
description: Hook the opponent's leg with qi along the curve then drag back so they fall beneath the following chop.

name: Sprig Guantang
description: Hold the pole slanted across the body with the blade raised so a cut can follow any block.

name: Rill Bladecollar
description: Slap the shaft sideways against an incoming weapon to knock it off its line.

name: Tuftscreen
description: Lift the blade edge up over the head and hold it there to cover against a falling blow.

name: Brutal Tailspike
description: Cleave down from behind the guard so the blade and the shaft arrive as one motion.

name: Crimson Longsweep
description: Swing the butt end up sharply to rap the opponent's wrist or jaw when they step inside the blade.

name: Loomglide
description: Slide the feet along the line of the guard so the body moves without opening a gap.

name: Sprig Guanhook
description: Spin the pole before the body with qi flowing through its length so thrown blows break against it.

name: Rill Crescentback
description: Turn a thrust aside on the shaft and let the same turn carry the blade down through the attacker.

name: Doughty Ironsweep
description: Pour qi into the shoulders and drive a single cleave through the opponent's raised weapon and onto their body.

name: Genial Heavyblade
description: Stand with the toes angled outward and the blade trailing behind so the body can turn in either direction.

name: Rushing Slashdown
description: Turn half around on the lead foot and let the blade finish a half wheel through the target.

name: Rigid Guanpole
description: Roll the pole over the forearms to meet a thrust and turn it away from the body.

name: Hiltswerve
description: Pivot on the lead foot and step the rear foot back so the opponent's strike passes the chest.

name: Rollcut Hammerfall
description: Spin fully on the lead foot while the crescent circles and qi builds in the wrists so the cut lands with the turn's force.

name: Crestbuckle
description: Spin inside an opponent's thrust and clamp their weapon's shaft between the pole and the ribs with qi held in the arm.

name: Patient Guantang
description: Slide both hands toward the tail of the pole and set the feet so the blade hangs far out in front.

name: Heavyswing Slap
description: Chop with the blade at the full stretch of the arms to reach an opponent before they can step in.

name: Hungry Polebelly
description: Jab the tip from the full length of the pole at the face of a closing opponent.

name: Loombuckle
description: Hold the long pole level across the front so any weapon must pass the whole length to reach the body.

name: Ducking Counterspike
description: Step back along the pole's line each time the opponent advances so the reach stays in the wielder's favor.

name: Hiltscorer
description: Lunge with the grip at the very tail and finish with a cut as qi runs the whole length of the pole.

name: Rough Crescentback
description: Sweep the blade tip across the front in repeating arcs backed by qi so opponents dare not step inside.

name: Tuftlinen
description: Lean the body slightly forward with the blade angled down so every cut carries the weight of the shoulders.

name: Polebelly Screen
description: Lean the pole's middle against an opponent's weapon and push to take their balance forward.

name: Entangling Counterspike
description: Lay the blade's edge across the opponent's weapon and press it to the ground.

name: Brawn Slashdown
description: Press the blade down through the target slowly rather than swinging so the edge keeps its line.

name: Savage Rollcut
description: Press the back of the curved blade against the opponent's chest and shove to open the guard.

name: Hilthurdle
description: Step forward with the blade still pressed against the opponent so they cannot find room to withdraw.

name: Acrid Guanpole
description: Let the pole drop its weight onto the opponent's forward foot through a quick release of the grip.

name: Fierce Redtassel
description: Pour qi into the shoulders and press the blade edge through a raised weapon and into the body behind it.

name: Clutching Longsweep
description: Lock the pole against the opponent's shaft and bear down with steady qi so their weapon cannot rise.

name: Unmoving Guantang
description: Step back out of an overbearing attack while the pole's qi-braced length covers the retreating body.

name: Poisetuft
description: Angle the blade's hook toward the opponent's weapon hand and set the stance to snare it.

name: Discord Bladecollar
description: Catch an enemy shaft in the hook and twist the pole to wrench the weapon off its line.

name: Raw Redtassel
description: Scrape the blade's edge down the length of the opponent's shaft and onto the hands holding it.

name: Brutal Heavyblade
description: Rap the pole's shaft sharply against the opponent's knuckles to loosen their grip.

name: Sleethilt
description: Raise the hooked blade over the face and shoulder to cover from a descending strike.

name: Rillguan
description: Step in along the hooked weapon's line so the opponent is pulled toward the wielder's body.

name: Discord Tailspike
description: Snare the opponent's weapon in the hook and wrench with qi in both arms until it leaves their grip.

name: Static Bladewheel
description: Whirl the pole between the hands and sweep the blade out so qi lengthens the cut past the opponent's guard.

name: Tenderhearted Polebelly
description: Stand with qi resting in the shoulders and the blade held high so the first cut can draw on it at once.

name: Lurching Guanhook
description: Let the blade fall lightly onto the target and carry qi down the edge only at the instant of contact.

name: Tuftbuckle
description: Turn a practice thrust aside with the shaft and bring the blade back to guard in one flow.

name: Prowling Ironsweep
description: Take two quick steps in the line of the cut so the feet always finish under the blade.

name: Bold Guantang
description: Carry qi from the shoulders through the whole slash and out along the edge into the target.

name: Guanhasp
description: Send a short pulse of qi into the shaft at the moment of impact to harden it against a heavy blow.
